sentences.text:
Sri. K.Satyanarayana, vs Commissioner Of Police, on 7 August,
2025

The Honourable Sri Justice Suddala Chalapathi Rao
 Writ Petition No.18143 Of 2017
Order:

This writ petition is filed seeking the following relief:
"...to issue an appropriate Writ, or direction, more particularly in the nature of Certiorari, to quash or set aside the departmental proceedings initiated by the respondents vide Charge Memo PR No.88 of 2014, dated 17.12.2014 by setting aside the charges against the petitioner by calling the entire records from the respondents and pass..."
2. Heard Sri Srinivas Alenur, learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home appearing on behalf of respondents.

3. When the matter is taken up for hearing, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home appearing on behalf of respondents submits that there is interim stay passed by this Court in W.P.M.P.No.22153 of 2017 dated 14.06.2017, and having regard to the fact that the disciplinary proceedings are initiated against the petitioner in pursuance of the criminal complaint filed by the wife of the petitioner under Section 498A of IPC and subsequently, the said complaint was withdrawn by the wife of the petitioner on 30.07.2015 in C.C.No.329 of 2014 on the file of XV Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate-cum- Special Court for the Trial of Video Piracy Cases,
Hyderabad, and in view of the same, the interim order passed as early as possible on 14.06.2017 and the disciplinary proceedings have been initiated in pursuance of a criminal case, which is not connected with the employment of the petitioner.
4. In view of the above, the Writ Petition is disposed of in terms of the interim order dated 14.06.2017 and the above impugned departmental proceedings dated 17.12.2014 are set aside.
There shall be no order as to costs.
_________________________________ SUDDALA CHALAPATHI RAO, J Date:
